maria (sec): Quick question — for Private deployments how do we want RBAC scoped? project-level roles in our control plane vs node-level agents? customers asking for 'isolation guarantees'.

ben (eng-platform): I'd push for minimal control-plane privileges for node agents. map customer org -> k8s namespace and use roleBindings per namespace. restrict cluster-admin to infra only. :thumbsup:

leah (eng-infra): Agree. Also default deny network policy between namespaces and only allow egress to specific control-plane endpoints and to KMS endpoints. Example k8s networkPolicy:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-egress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
```

jon (eng-ml): How do we handle KMS outages? customers want their data encrypted with their KMS but also want fail-open to avoid downtime.

maria (sec): No fail-open for customer keys. If KMS unreachable we should fall back to cached envelope keys that were pre-wrapped with customer KMS and rotated periodically. Documented fallback: cached-envelopes + audit flag.

dave (support): Customer reported an incident where KMS auth token expired and model serving degraded. We should add alerting: KMS auth failures >3m -> Pager.

ben (eng-platform): For RBAC changes, we need migration path. Propose: 1) introduce least-priv role, 2) rollout in canary namespaces, 3) auto-scan for overly-permissive bindings, 4) enforce via admission controller (OPA/rego)

leah (eng-infra): + add network-level verification in our deploy pipeline: run a dry-run to ensure netpols are present. Also whitelist IPs for control-plane -> customer VPC, and use mTLS for agent-control-plane comms.

maria (sec): Audit logging: everything KMS-related, RBAC changes, and key-usage should be forwarded to customer's syslog endpoint and stored in our audit bucket (encrypted with customer key). Retention policy per contract.

sec-bot: New policy draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal/drive/priv-deploys/rbac-kms-draft.md :eyes:

jon (eng-ml): One more: ensure model-serving cache (KV) never persists plaintext secrets — encrypt at rest with envelope keys and prune on scale-down.

dave (support): I'll add an incident runbook step: "If KMS compromise suspected -> rotate envelopes, revoke agent certs, isolate affected namespaces".

maria (sec): OK let's sync tomorrow 11am. Agenda: migration plan, fallback design, audit pipeline, runbook actions. Thanks all.
